findings.evidence: Lines 26–28 claim sufficiency because the elements generate; closure_insert_gl2WeylElement_eq_top only establishes generation, and lines 212–213 correctly assert only uniqueness.
findings.fix: State that compatible actions determine at most one GL₂-action, matching the generation theorem's docstring.
findings.issue: Saying that adding actions of the centre and Weyl element suffices to obtain a GL₂-action omits compatibility relations; generation guarantees uniqueness, not existence.

findings.evidence: Lines 22–23 make the unqualified claim. The one-dimensional trivial smooth representation cannot be compactly induced from K: any nonzero such induction has infinite dimension since GL₂(ℚ_p)/K is infinite.
findings.fix: Remove the compact-induction claim or replace it with a precisely qualified statement.
findings.issue: The module docstring claims smooth representations of GL₂(ℚ_p) are compactly induced with respect to K; this is false for general smooth representations.

summary: Two module docstrings overclaim the representation-theoretic consequences of the constructions.
